_doc: The Babbby site's languages; code is the babbby-ios lproj id (Babbby/Babbby/Resources/<code>.lproj), also the locale folder name. label: the language's own name as the language switcher shows it. hreflang: the code Google accepts, also <html lang>. pathPrefix: hreflang in lowercase ('' for en, the x-default). ogLocale: og:locale. shipped: true once the language has its own URLs, hreflang entries and sitemap lines. kind: source | owner | generated | translated (generated = zh-Hans from zh-Hant by scripts/gen-zh-hans.mjs; translated = from en only, by scripts/l10n.mjs). Rules: docs/specs/seo-aeo.md §多語系 URL.
